class.name: WeatherLibrary
class.brief_description: The weather types a [Weather] node can choose from.
class.description: A list of [WeatherProfile]s, chosen by their [member WeatherProfile.display_name]. A new weather type is a new profile in the list; no code. Save a library as a resource to share it between levels.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Returns a new library with the built-in weather types: Clear, Partly Cloudy, Windy, Overcast, Mist, Fog, Drizzle, Light Rain, Heavy Rain, Storm and Thunderstorm. Use it as a starting point for your own.

method.name: find
method.description: The profile whose display name is [param name], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_default
method.description: The built-in library, used by [Weather] nodes without one. It is shared: [method Resource.duplicate] a profile before changing it.

method.name: get_names
method.description: The display names of the profiles, in order.
